definition: Identifier of the payment row attached to this invoice.
Unique identifier of one invoice (one billing cycle for one customer).
Identifier of the customer billed on this invoice.
Amount recorded on the payment row, in euros.

Finance snapshot on 12 September 2026. paid = a payment_date is recorded (including paid after the due date). unpaid = no payment yet, and the due date has not passed. overdue = no payment, and the due date has already passed. overdue is not 'paid late'.
Date a payment was recorded. Empty when no payment has been recorded (unpaid or overdue invoices).
